title: The Origin and Evolution of the Earth

topics.title: Early Theories: Origin of the Earth

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the nebular hypothesis of Kant and Laplace and its revision by Otto Schmidt and Carl Weizascar.

topics.title: Origin of the Universe: the Big Bang Theory

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the stages in the development of the universe according to the Big Bang Theory.
Interpret the evidence for an expanding universe and contrast it with the steady state concept.
Explain how density differences in the early universe led to nebulae, galaxies and stars.
Use the light year as a measure of distance in simple calculations.
Sequence the stages by which planetesimals accreted into planets.

topics.title: Evolution of the Earth and its Lithosphere
topics.ncert_sections: Evolution of the Earth; Evolution of Lithosphere

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the layered structure of the earth and the change in density from crust to core.
Explain how differentiation separated earth material into layers.
Identify the three stages in the evolution of the present atmosphere.
Explain degassing and the formation of oceans and atmospheric oxygen.
Explain the origin of life as a chemical process and the fossil evidence for its age.
